svg.title: Targeted-Offer and Transfer Desk
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-06-capital-one-shopping-desk; chapter number: 11; title: Targeted-Offer and Transfer Desk; subtitle: Capital One Shopping offers, the $80 referral, and cents-per-point transfer hurdles; chart type: org_architecture; center: role: Offer and Transfer Operator; headcount: Solo operator; focus: Browse, log out, return for targeted offers; run Capital One Shopping and Rakuten in separate browsers; screenshot every offer and claim after 30 days.; spokes: role: Targeted Offer Hunter; type: Portal offers; kpi: $45 back on $75 and $160 back on $200; over $500 in three months (Michael Martinez); role: Referral Bonus Runner; type: Signup bonus; kpi: $80 on a $1 Finish Line donation after a 90-day wait (Nate Bind); role: Transfer Partner Analyst; type: Points redemption; kpi: 2 cents per point hurdle; Grand Hyatt Vail at 2.2 cents (AskSebby); role: Transfer Bonus Watcher; type: Promotional bonus; kpi: 80% Chase-to-IHG bonus lifts 0.6 to 1.08 cents per point (Ben Hedges); caption: The default 0.5 to 2 percent portal rate is noise; the money sits in targeted offers, the $80 referral, and transfers that clear a cents-per-point hurdle.; assumptions note: Payouts land only as gift cards and take one to three months; transfers are not reversible, so price the award first (Thrive Media, Mark Reese).; note: Sources - Michael Martinez, Nate Bind, AskSebby, Ben Hedges, Mark Reese, Twin Finances.
